description: Pick 1 or more items from a list of up to 1000, each equally likely. Without repeats by default. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

seed.description: Optional. 64 hex characters. Give the seed shown on an earlier result page to get the same result again (that is how a draw is checked). Leave it out for a fresh draw.

name: pick_from_list
title: Pick from a list
